name: CBHB
recent: CBH Engineering 近期获得一份价值 RM50.98 million 的 Kelantan 太阳能项目 EPC 合约，并公布季度业绩创下纪录。同时，董事与大股东 Cheah 家族在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报增持股份。
notable: 子公司获得 Kelantan 太阳能项目价值 RM50.98 million 的 EPC 合约。
公布季度业绩，净利创纪录。
董事 Cheah Boon Hwa 及 Cheah Min Heng 等多次申报增持公司股份。
risks: 董事在闭门期前申报拟交易股份，随后于闭门期内进行交易。
earnings: 最新季度 (截至 2026-06-30) 营收 RM120.928 million，净利 RM24.529 million，净利率 20.3%；营收环比增 35.1%、同比增 102.6%，净利环比增 34.9%、同比增 142.7%。

recent_en: CBH Engineering recently secured a RM50.98 million EPC contract for a solar project in Kelantan and reported record quarterly earnings. Meanwhile, directors and major shareholder the Cheah family filed multiple notices of share acquisitions between September and November.
notable_en: A subsidiary secured a RM50.98 million EPC contract for a solar project in Kelantan.
Directors including Cheah Boon Hwa and Cheah Min Heng filed multiple notices of share acquisitions.
risks_en: A director declared intention to deal during the closed period and subsequently traded within the closed period.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (ended 30 Jun 2026) revenue was RM120.928 million with net profit of RM24.529 million and net margin of 20.3%; revenue rose 35.1% QoQ and 102.6% YoY, while net profit grew 34.9% QoQ and 142.7% YoY.
